show.name: Седьмой игрок
show.summary:
"Stroitel" club was once a successful team, and its owner dreamed of one day having the chance to move beyond its current league and earn a place in the KHL. But the players and coaching staff have fallen into a deep slump, leaving the team at the bottom of the standings with no way out. Now, it seems easier to shut down the club and its arena altogether. Losing faith in the team's chances of turning things around on the ice, "Stroitel's" owner appoints a figure skating coach as the club's director.

The club's survival now depends on whether the former skater can unite the players, forge a bond between the team and its fans, who are considered the equivalent of a sixth player on the ice, and become the club's "seventh player" by finding success from behind the management desk.

show.name: Shixiong A Shixiong
show.summary:
After being reborn in ancient times before the Great God-Conferment War, Li Changshou became a small cultivator.

To survive in the cruel Primordial Times, Li Changshou tries hard not to accumulate any karma. He always plans thoroughly before doing anything and never allows himself to walk into dangerous situations. He hides his trump cards well, trains himself in escape techniques, refines poisonous pills, and masters mystical abilities.
Li Changshou originally planned to remain hidden and safe in the mountain until his ascension to immortality. However, everything changed one year when his master brought home a junior sister…

When a dangerous game of temptation and taboo takes an unexpected turn — a student mysteriously disappears, and everyone believes their secrets will be buried forever. But the arrival of a new face becomes the first domino to fall. The carefully constructed lies, hidden desires, and painful truths of the past begin to unravel, exposing a world of deception and obsession one layer at a time.

show.name: Where the Mask Ends
show.summary: Chou was once a lowly night-soil collector, bullied and mistreated by everyone around her. But her striking resemblance to Wei Rao, the daughter of a marquis, unexpectedly makes her the bride of Lu Zhuo, the heir to a duke's household, in a marriage arranged to bring him good fortune and save his life. Ambitious and determined to rise above her station, Chou sees the marriage as her chance to climb the social ladder. However, her critically ill husband suddenly awakens, and her assumption of another woman's place brings one disaster after another. Furious that Chou has taken her place, Wei Rao is desperate to get rid of her. Meanwhile, Lu Zhuo regards Chou as a vicious and scheming woman, constantly guarding against her and plotting against her. Beneath the seemingly harmonious facade of the duke's household lie countless traps and deadly schemes. Caught in the midst of these hidden conflicts, Chou struggles to navigate the competing interests around her while carefully planning her future. Determined to break free from the shackles of fate, she eventually uncovers the secrets of her own origins and reunites with her loved ones. Rising from a humble night-soil collector to a woman of status, she transforms her life and creates a brilliant future for herself.

After joining the Dongda Martial Arts Academy, Qin Yu gradually befriends a group of chivalrous companions, cultivating and growing together to protect their school and their planet .

As their rivalry intensifies, they gradually transform each other while witnessing one another bravely chasing their dreams — a heartwarming love story that evolves from bickering rivals into a textbook romance.

show.name: Besties' Coming Fortune
show.summary: Modern-day best friends Tian Yuyuan and Lin Shutiao unexpectedly find themselves transported into a novel about household power struggles. They become sisters-in-law destined to be framed in a flower boat scandal on their wedding night and die together as sacrificial characters. The two team up to thwart the eldest sister-in-law and the adopted daughter, Shen Wanwan, as they expose one scheme and trap after another, making money along the way to survive. Shen Cheng, the cold and aloof heir, is afflicted with a deadly poison and needs the heroine's blood to stay alive, while Shen He, the unruly third young master, secretly aspires to become a coroner. Romance gradually blossoms between the two couples. However, the reborn original heroine Song Zhang and the Third Prince, who plots rebellion, launch a series of attacks. The four join forces to investigate an old case at Qiyun Pass, find witnesses who can testify to the injustice, and expose the Third Prince's serious crimes. They clear the Shen family's name and ultimately escape their predetermined tragic fate, living peacefully together.

show.name: Dear Song
show.summary: To seek justice for her father, Yu Song takes a job as an assistant in the Song household. Her sincerity wins Song Cheng over, and she teams up with Jing, a driver, to gather evidence and expose the Song family's crimes. But she refuses to let hatred consume her. She breaks free from what has held her back and realizes that real victory means taking control of her own life. In the end, she embraces life with newfound freedom and hope.

show.name: Emmerdale
show.summary: Emmerdale is a British soap focusing on the lives of several families and locals living around an estate, a farm and the nearby village in the Yorkshire Dales. It is the second longest British soap in television history since airing its first episode on ITV in 1972, as 'Emmerdale Farm', the show was renamed in 1989.

show.name: Target
show.summary: Mark is a high school student at an elite school, whose carefree life ends one day: his beloved girlfriend Ailin becomes distant with zero explanation. At the same time, Mark begins to see strange targeted messages on his social media feed, which seem to be messages from the future as they describe events that begin to happen in real life. When he receives a "target" predicting that a life-threatening fire will break out at the school, he realizes he must act. Now, Mark needs not only to figure out his relationship with Ailin, but also to prevent a catastrophe by finding the arsonist. Having managed to convince his peers that the danger is real, they set out to prevent a catastrophe.

Beim Austausch einer Relaisbox finden die Bergretter eine Tonaufzeichnung von emotionaler Sprengkraft: Es sind die letzten Worte des verunglückten Bergsteigers Anton Höller.

Isa Höller und ihren Sohn Elias hoffen, durch die gefundenen Aufnahmen mehr über den tragischen Tod ihres Ehemanns und Vaters zu erfahren. Als eine weitere Aufnahme auftaucht, ist klar: Dem Unfall ging anscheinend ein Streit voraus – doch mit wem?

show.name: Die Bergretter
show.summary: Die Bergretter is a German mountain rescue television series. The series is set in the Austrian Alps and centers around a fictional mountain rescue team in Ramsau am Dachstein. Each episode focuses on a rescue mission, explores the background stories of the people involved the incident (more often than not caused by their risky behaviour) and the private lives of the team members.

Channel 10 states the bulletin aims to offer viewers a detailed wrap-up of the day's major stories, delivered in a digital-first format that allows audiences to tune in from any device, at their convenience.

body.name: Episode 1
body.summary: After being evicted from their flat, three friends in their twenties cling to their friendship while the world falls apart around them. In the first episode, best friends Ethan, Abi and Sam scramble to repair the damage in their London flat before they're thrown out for good. The trio are determined to escape reality with one last night out but as the night spirals, long-buried tensions surface.

show.name: It Gets Worse
show.summary:
It Gets Worse follows Ethan, Abi, and Sam - best friends from uni, soulmates for life, and dysfunctional roommates. It's been a year since they finally managed to move to London, they have collectively accomplished nothing, and now their landlord is selling up. They're getting kicked out. What now? Can they keep their friendships alive when they are dispersed across a city that seems to want them dead? Can they find a six out of ten or higher to have bad sex with? Can they get their shit together when the world is so obviously falling apart? Probably not. But they're going to have fun trying.

It Gets Worse is a show about three young people who are starting to look around themselves - at their humiliating jobs, their non-existent love lives and their rapidly dwindling will to live - and think: wait. Wait wait WAIT. Surely it gets better than this? It has to get better than this. Right? Spoiler alert! It doesn't.

body.name: Episode 2
body.summary: Abi seems to have it all - a nice flat with her boyfriend, a new promotion, a more adult life. But beneath the surface, cracks are beginning to show. None of them, even three stronger than god masters, whose power could pierce the heavens, have been able to return alive. A hundred years later, his descendant, Su Beitian, suffers humiliation but resists fiercely, unexpectedly inheriting the Alchemy God's legacy and returning with overwhelming power! Awakening his dual-elemental martial veins of ice and fire, he re-cultivates the Alchemy God's techniques, becoming a young hero. As he investigates the truth behind his mother's disappearance, a series of conspiracies gradually surface. Witness Su Beitian overcome tribulations, unravel the ultimate martial arts, and become the supreme master of alchemy!

show.summary: American Pulse is an hour showcasing reporting from the vast network of CNN affiliates across the country.

show.name: Critical Role Cooldown
show.summary: Get a backstage pass to a Critical Role episode. You'll be right there at the table immediately after Matt says "Is it Thursday yet?", experiencing the cast's post-show reactions. Share in the tumult of theories, the chaos of questions, and the pitching of plans from the cast after the show. If you've ever wondered what lies just beyond the curtain, this is your chance to find out. Starting with Campaign 3, Episode 83, you'll get instant access to 10 episodes with new episodes dropping every Thursday with each new Critical Role episode.

show.name: BattleBots Pro League
show.summary: BattleBots Pro League powered by Bright Data is the toughest robot combat event on the planet. 24 elite bots from across the globe converge on Las Vegas for the ultimate fight to the death. There are 6 Groups of 4 bots, each of which has to fight everyone in the Group. The Group winners progress to the Knockout rounds, so every fight matters and there are no second chances.

show.name: Twisted Tie
show.summary:
If you cross the line any further, Team Leader... I don't know what I'll do.

A romantic and entangled story set in a workplace environment between an employee and his team leader/boss.

show.name: Fool in Love
show.summary: Set in Bangkok, a rapidly rising commercial capital where money, power, fame, and resources intertwine on an elite stage, the story follows Ing, the eldest son of the Jian family — a proud, unruly, and stunningly beautiful business prodigy. His dazzling achievements fuel his half-brother's near-pathological jealousy. Yok is the second son of the Li family, bearing heavy family expectations. Gentle and exceptionally intelligent on the outside, he is a former reserve professional boxer weighed down by family pressure. After meeting Ing, Yok's suppressed self quietly awakens. The two are drawn into an intense dance of love and hatred.

show.name: Did someone happen to mention me?
Did someone happen to mention me?
Till I See You
show.summary: Song Yi, a wealthy young man raised in Japan, travels to Northern China in search of answers about his father's past and unexpectedly becomes Xu Feiyu's temporary caregiver. Recovering from eye surgery with his eyes still covered in bandages, Feiyu slowly lowers his guard under Song Yi's domineering yet tender care. Before they can truly ""see"" each other, they have already fallen in love. But just as Feiyu is about to regain his sight, a devastating secret comes to light, forcing Song Yi to disappear without a word. Five years later, fate brings them together again. Can their unforgettable love finally be made whole?

show.name: The Howard Stern Show
show.summary: Legendary innovator, broadcaster, and "King of All Media" Howard Stern brings his signature, long-running SiriusXM show to HBO Max.

show.name: Second Plate
show.summary:
Kang Yu Hyeon once dreamed of becoming a chef and entered culinary school with complete confidence in his abilities. However, after meeting his exceptionally talented junior, O Min Gyeom, he is forced to confront a level of skill he cannot surpass. Unable to come to terms with the gap between them, Yu Hyeon gives up on his dream and drops out of university. 

Years later, Yu Hyeon is living an ordinary life as a product developer at a food company. Just when he thinks the past is behind him, he reunites with Min Gyeom, who has become a renowned chef, when the two are assigned to collaborate on the development of a new product.

As old wounds resurface and lingering feelings refuse to fade, the reunion challenges both men to face the past they never truly left behind.

show.name: Love on Hire
show.summary: Thitinan will take any job—being a fake girlfriend and breaking up a relationship, or, special just for Miss Chat, becoming a bedroom coach.

show.name: Hell Barrister
show.summary: Yau Yum Yum is a lawyer with more enemies than friends. One day, she is attacked and met a deceased rich man on her deathbed. His intention is to send Yau back to the world of the living to be his lawyer. He needs Yau to manage his assets. Yau gets possessed by spirits and travels between the two "worlds". She witnesses how ugly and ridiculous inheritance disputes can get. It makes her wonder the true meaning of inheritance, and whether it is a blessing or a curse.

The two-hour program will also feature segments on finance, business, technology, AI and other consequential topics, leveraging Romans' role as NBC News' chief business correspondent.

show.summary:
Days of our Lives is set in the fictitious Midwestern town of Salem. The core families are the Bradys, the Hortons and the DiMeras, and the multi-layered storylines involve elements of romance, adventure, mystery, comedy and drama.

Beginning on September 12, 2022, DAYS became exclusive to streaming on Peacock.

show.summary: Voice actor Matthew Mercer leads a group of fellow voice actors on epic Dungeons & Dragons campaigns. These familiar voices bring the audience into the full experience of D&D, allowing imaginations to soar as the characters embark on adventures. This is Critical Role!

body.name: She Has a Vision
body.summary: While Khloé reflects on her patterns in relationships, Kourtney supports her stepkids through big events in their lives. Kim manifests her dream man while starring in a new film, and Kendall reaches a major life goal: buying her dream home.

show.name: The Kardashians
show.summary: Just when you think life can't get any faster in the Kardashian-Jenner family, they punch it into overdrive. From the big screen to baby bliss, the family continues to defy expectations in all their endeavors. Cameras roll as Kourtney, Kim, Khloé, Kendall, and Kylie navigate contentious sister dynamics, all under the watchful eye of everyone's favorite matriarch, Kris.

show.name: NBC News Daily
show.summary: NBC News provides viewers with up-to-the-minute national and international news.

show.name: Blue Skies
show.summary:
Blue Skies is an all-new procedural series blending mystery, action, and emotional storytelling, centered on the powerful bond between a detective and her canine companion.

Set in the stunning Crystal Ridge National Park, the series follows former military police officer Jodi Larsen as she returns to her hometown to serve as a criminal investigator for the National Park Police. As Jodi protects the park and its visitors from both natural and human threats, she navigates a new team, personal loss, and an unexpected partnership with Blue, a mischievous stray Labrador whose instincts prove invaluable in solving cases.

The canine, Blue, a golden Labrador Retriever is played by three brothers, River, Comet and Canyon. River is considered the "star" of the three.

show.name: Swipe Right on the Devil
show.summary: When 24-year-old Sydney Loofe disappears after a Tinder date, what begins as a missing-person case quickly spirals into a haunting mystery. As investigators race to uncover her whereabouts, they are drawn into an astounding world of manipulation, witchcraft, mind control and black magic. Each new lead uncovers disturbing revelations, exposing behavior that shocks even seasoned FBI agents. With every answer raising new questions, Sydney's story becomes a cautionary tale about trust, vulnerability and the hidden dangers that can lurk behind seemingly ordinary encounters, culminating in a chilling case that remains as perplexing as it is unforgettable.

RuPaul's search for the UK's Next Drag Race Superstar continues with makeover week!

RuPaul tasks the remaining queens with giving some very special guests a drag makeover - members of their own family. Emotions are high as the queens work against the clock to transform their family members into drag beauties. The question remains: between the tears and laughter, which queen will impress Ru the most?

Singer-songwriter Cat Burns joins her fellow Celebrity Traitor Alan Carr on the judging panel alongside Michelle Visage as Mama Ru decides the fate of another queen.
